name: platform_commands_at_open_quote
notes: D5: inside `'…'` the full filtered PLATFORM_COMMANDS table is offered (40 entries − `_`/`__`/`_{` = 37). Item shape is TS toItems: kind Function, detail from the table, 3-digit index sortText, filterText = table key, plain insert (no entry contains `$`, D18). Range starts right after the quote.

items_spot.label: fm3 <mask>
items_spot.documentation_contains: Enable FM3 special mode for selected operators

name: platform_commands_typing_prefix
notes: D5: the list is not narrowed server-side while typing; only the replace range grows to cover the typed word (start = first char after the opening quote).

name: platform_commands_start_column_after_inner_space
notes: D5 start-column rule: last whitespace inside the quoted run wins over the quote itself — `A 'fm3 000` replaces only `000` (chars 7..10).

name: platform_commands_exclude_transpose_forms
notes: D5: `_`, `__` and `_{` (PLATFORM_COMMANDS[0..3]) are dropped by isQuotedPlatformCommand even when the user typed `_`; the list is still the same 37 entries starting at `fm3` (index 0 would be `_<-128..127>` without the filter).
